<Heading
  as={"h1"}

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/packages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Read-only query returning every Package sealed for `orderRef` — the Package-side twin of `GET /tasks?orderRef=` (same query-parameter contract, same 400 on a missing or empty `orderRef`, same empty array for an unrecognized one). An order normally yields one carton, but a multi-carton order or a re-pack after a SLAM diversion yields several, so treat the response as a set. Ordered by package id. Side-effect-free (see [ADR-0033](https://iqvo.github.io/fulfillment-execution/docs/adr/0033-package-read-model)).
